summary: Allocates rectangular regions in a texture atlas from two free-space lists. Allocates a 36-byte horizontal region node and a 28-byte vertical region node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, configures their flags/width/height/bounds from the request object, and links them into sorted doubly-linked free lists keyed by remaining space. When a fit is found the caller-side node state is advanced; on validation failure it reports aErrorCreatingV through sub_53C590 and returns -1.

operations.description: Allocate a 36-byte horizontal region node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and zero-initialize all nine dwords.
Store the horizontal node pointer into the request object (a2[7], anchored through *(this+0x118C)+0x14) and initialize node fields: flags from a2[14], width default 1234, height default 64.
Allocate a 28-byte vertical region node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and zero-initialize all seven dwords.

Store the vertical node pointer into the request object (a2[9]) and initialize it: flags from a2[14] with bit-0x20 normalization (clear bit 0x20, set bit 0x1 when it was set) and bound from a2[4]. The allocator list state at this+0x1154 is zero-initialized.
Branch on the allocator-enabled flag at this+0x13DC; when unset the pre-allocated nodes are validated directly without list insertion.

Select the horizontal free-list head by dimension flag: this+0x1158 when bit 0x20 of a2[14] is set, otherwise this+0x1150. Compute the effective bound as max(selected head bound, requested a2[2]) and read the secondary dimension from this+0x1160.

Walk the horizontal free list while the requested width exceeds the node's free space (node bound minus node current offset), advancing through the node next-link field (offset 0x18) and the list-head next-link (offset 0x1C) until a fit is found or the list ends.

When no horizontal node fits, allocate a new 36-byte node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, append it at the list tail with back/forward links, and initialize it with the effective bound, flags from a2[14], width 1234 and height 64.
Validate the horizontal placement with sub_540DF0; a non-zero result aborts with -1.
Consume horizontal space: report the node's current offset to the request (a2[11]), advance the node offset by a2[2], and store the node's assigned region id back into the request node.

Walk the vertical free list from this+0x1164 while the requested height exceeds the node's free space (node bound minus node offset), advancing through the node next-link fields (offsets 0x28, 0x2C, 0x38) until a fit is found or the list ends.

When no vertical node fits, allocate a new 28-byte node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, append it at the vertical list tail (head at this+0x1164) with back/forward links, and initialize its flags and bound; the node bound field at offset 0x54 is written.
Validate the vertical placement with sub_540FC0; a non-zero result aborts with -1.
Consume vertical space: report the node's current offset to the request (a2[12]), advance the node offset by a2[4], and store the node's assigned region id into the request node.

Disabled-allocator path: validate the horizontal node (a2[7]) with sub_540DF0 and the vertical node (a2[9]) with sub_540FC0; on any failure log aErrorCreatingV through sub_53C590 and return -1, otherwise clear the reported offsets and return 0.

if (!node2) { node2 = alloc_zeroed(28); splice_tail(&this->vert_list, node2); init(node2, bound2); }
